sections.content_md:
SoftMask: 自监督学习的软掩码方法

SoftMask Author Team

sections.title: Motivation
sections.content_md: Self-supervised learning uses masking. Hard masking discards information.

sections.title: Method Overview
sections.content_md: SoftMask uses learnable continuous weights for input patches instead of binary masking.

sections.title: Method
sections.content_md:
SoftMask uses learnable continuous weights for input patches instead of binary masking.

**Key Formulas:**
- $$ M = sigma(MLP(x)) $$
  Soft mask via sigmoid MLP

sections.title: Experiments
sections.content_md:
**Datasets:** ImageNet, COCO
**Metrics:** Top-1, AP
**Results:** 76.5% top-1
**Takeaways:**
- Soft masking outperforms hard masking
- Gradient preservation is key

sections.title: Contributions
sections.content_md:
- **[method]** Proposes soft masking for SSL
- **[application]** SOTA on ImageNet and COCO

sections.title: Highlights
sections.content_md:
1. Soft masking outperforms hard masking
2. Gradient preservation is key
